steps.text: Prioritize rest. Your sleep was shorter than your target and resting heart rate is above your reference. Consider your scheduled rest routine and reassess when appropriate.

Consider a mindfulness session. Resting heart rate is higher and HRV lower than your reference. This does not establish stress or its cause. If you feel well, a brief mindfulness session may be helpful.
Review your activity plan. Recorded activity is below your plan. Check for missing entries and follow your existing approved plan; do not increase intensity based on this alert.

Bone-health countermeasure reminder. The mission model highlights the importance of bone-health countermeasures. It does not measure your bone density. Review adherence to your prescribed exercise plan.
